meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作并渲染视频、动画与动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想快速制作宣传视频或动态图形,而不想从零写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos, animations, and motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly produce promo videos or motion graphics without coding from scratch.

howto.what: 收到制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画、动态图形的请求时,Claude 会先读取本技能,据此选择并执行对应的制作流程;对已有 HyperFrames 项目,则恢复项目状态、检查并升级渲染工具,并支持诊断、预览、发布等操作。
howto.when: 当你说要做、改或渲染视频、动画、动态图形(如宣传片、幻灯片、字幕片段等),或要检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时,该技能会作为入口被触发。

say.text: 把这个 GitHub PR 做成一个讲解视频。
say.note: 会路由到 PR 讲解视频工作流。

say.text: 用这段音乐生成一段节奏同步的动画。
say.note: 会匹配音乐驱动视频流程。

say.text: 检查我的项目并重新渲染以发布。
say.note: 会恢复项目状态并校验渲染工具。

howto.what_en: For any video/animation/motion-graphic request, Claude reads this skill first, picks the matching workflow, and runs it. Existing HyperFrames projects get state restored, render-tool check/upgrade, and support for inspect, preview, or publish.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any request to make, edit, animate, or render a video/animation/motion graphic, or to inspect, diagnose, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this GitHub PR into an explainer video.
Make a beat-synced animation from this music track.
say_en.note: Routes to the music-driven video workflow.

say_en.text: Check my project and re-render it for publishing.
say_en.note: Restores project state and verifies the render tool.
